title: from_file/merge_from_file accept impl AsRef<Path>
description: Previous API took &str for path, forcing callers to do .to_str().unwrap(). The refactor changed to impl AsRef<Path> which accepts &str, &Path, PathBuf, and NamedTempFile::path() directly. Tests no longer call .to_str().unwrap(). A future contributor might suggest reverting to &str for simplicity — the AsRef<Path> form is strictly better: it handles non-UTF-8 paths on Unix, removes the unwrap() at every call site, and matches std::fs API conventions.
